shared_elements: carved/incised linear marks on a stone surface
horizontal registers or bands of repeated marks
justification: A depicts a fully anthropomorphic standing figure in relief, with a head, headdress, arms converging on the torso, a central disc on the chest and banded geometric motifs below, whereas B shows only faint horizontal rows of small repeated incised signs on an otherwise blank, largely natural rock face. The only correspondence is the generic presence of shallow incised marks organised in horizontal registers, which any carving tradition could produce; no figure, no disc and no comparable composition appears in B.
